dict.string: Gyozaclikr asks Notes (and Mail, if you choose silent sending) to save or send what you wrote.
Gyozaclikr captures the region of the screen you draw, to read its text and answer questions about it. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
Gyozaclikr adds the reminders you ask for. It never reads your existing reminders.
Gyozaclikr adds the events you ask for. It never reads your calendar.
Gyozaclikr looks up an address when you ask it to mail a person by name.
